remarks: PLEASE READ WHAT THE RENT INCLUDES. Updated 3-Bedroom Home with Finished Basement, Central Air & Attached 2-Car Garage. The monthly RENT INCLUDES professional landscaping, snow and winter debris removal, and water usage up to $75 per month, allowing you to enjoy a truly low-maintenance lifestyle.  Welcome to 142 North Taylor Avenue, where modern updates, generous living space, and carefree living come together in one exceptional rental opportunity.  This beautifully maintained, move-in-ready home features three spacious bedrooms, updated interiors, central air conditioning, forced-air heating, and a finished lower level offering the flexibility to create a family room, home office, fitness area, media room, or playroom. An attached two-car garage provides ample parking and additional storage, while the private backyard offers the perfect setting for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying the outdoors.  Conveniently located just minutes from shopping, restaurants, parks, schools, Metro-North, and major commuter routes, this home combines the privacy of a single-family residence with exceptional accessibility.  If you're searching for a turnkey rental that offers comfort, space, and convenience, 142 North Taylor Avenue is ready to welcome you home.
